states.revealedText:
SEARCH:
Hollow Men have headquarters here. The whole
city lives in fear of them. They come from Asia
and new members appear every year in
November. We must tread carefully.
We are heading into darkness.
Immediately take 1 Player card from the discard
pile and add it to your hand.
states.effect: Immediately take 1 Player card from the discard pile and add it to your hand. The printed label is SEARCH:. The scratch calls this the Hollow Men headquarters: the city lives in fear of them, they come from Asia, and new members appear every year in November. No companion stays on the card.

rules: Black Player card for Riyadh. Not a port.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is the scratched face.
Scratching it immediately takes 1 Player card from the Player discard pile into your hand. No companion.
notes: Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
The card does not say what to do if the Player discard pile is empty.
The scratch panel fills the center. No bullseye upgrade mark is printed.
